answer_key._how: Judgment labels only, per profile. Every activity not listed for a profile is irrelevant to it. breaks = hard-constraint ids the activity text shows it breaks (cost, format, alcohol, location; weekly caps such as max_hours_per_week are listed too and also checked in code); schedule fit is NOT stored, code computes it from available_windows. preference_satisfied = which of the student's current soft_preferences (current_truth.soft_preferences, by id) each relevant event satisfies. Valid = event that is relevant, not a dislike, breaks nothing, and fits the schedule. Correct answer (best_ranked_preference) = the valid event that is best when the satisfied preferences are compared lexicographically by rank (S1 first, then the next rank, ...).
